posts.title: sveltejs/svelte
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Svelte는 선언적 컴포넌트를 효율적인 JavaScript 코드로 컴파일하여 DOM을 정밀하게 업데이트하는 웹 애플리케이션 빌드 도구입니다. 이는 전통적인 프레임워크와 달리 런타임에서가 아니라 빌드 단계에서 코드가 최적화되어 실행 성능을 높이는 접근법을 제공합니다. 공식 웹사이트와 Discord 채팅방에서 추가 정보를 얻을 수 있습니다. 오픈 소스 프로젝트로서 활발히 개발 중이며 자원봉사자들의 참여로 유지되고 있습니다.

## 주요 기능

- 컴파일 기반 프레임워크로 런타임 오버헤드 최소화
- 선언적 컴포넌트 작성 및 DOM을 효율적으로 갱신
- JavaScript로 변환되어 빠른 실행 가능
- MIT 라이선스를 적용하여 자유로운 이용 가능

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- 웹 애플리케이션 개발 시 빠른 동작과 작은 번들 크기가 필요한 프로젝트
- 프레임워크 런타임 부하를 줄이고자 하는 UI 컴포넌트 개발
- 학습이 쉬운 모던 웹 개발 방법론 체험
- 오픈 소스 생태계에서 활발한 커뮤니티 지원 활용

## 시작하기

README에는 별도의 설치 및 시작 방법 명시가 없으나, 추가 정보와 문서는 공식 사이트(svelte.dev)에서 확인 가능하다.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- 컴파일러 개념이 익숙하지 않은 개발자에게는 다소 진입 장벽 존재 가능
- 런타임이 아닌 빌드 타임 변환 방식을 이해해야 함
- `.dev` 도메인 웹사이트 접속 문제 가능성에 대한 안내가 포함됨

posts.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

last30days-skill is an AI agent-based search tool that aggregates recent content from multiple platforms including Reddit, X (Twitter), YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and others to provide a synthesized, engagement-ranked summary about a topic. It leverages real engagement signals like upvotes, likes, and market odds rather than editor-curated content, offering fresh insights often missing from traditional search engines. The tool supports numerous data sources for research on people, companies, trends, and events within the last 30 days. This approach enables users to prepare for meetings, monitor emerging topics, or stay informed about ongoing developments effectively.

## 주요 기능

- Aggregates and synthesizes data across diverse platforms (social media, news, research, market data).
- Ranks information based on real user engagement such as upvotes, likes, and betting odds.
- Supports discovery mode to surface trending topics with velocity rankings and cross-source analysis.
- Provides specialized 'secret signals' like patent filings and job postings to detect upcoming company actions.

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Prepare for meetings by gathering recent relevant information on individuals or companies.
- Monitor real-time trends and topics exploding in popularity across communities.
- Research companies' unannounced projects via patent and hiring insights.
- Get comprehensive, multi-source summaries about persons, products, or news stories not covered by conventional search engines.

## 시작하기

Installation options include using Claude Code's plugin marketplace, Grok CLI, npx agent skills for over 50 hosts, or manual installation via cloning the GitHub repo and symlinking. After installation, run the `/last30days` command with your topic query. Some data sources require API keys or tokens, which you can provide for fuller access. The README provides detailed installation and setup instructions for different platforms.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Full functionality requires API keys or tokens for some platforms (e.g., X/Twitter, YouTube).
- Some integrations depend on additional CLI tools or browser sessions for authentication.
- Windows support for Claude Desktop is deferred as of now.
- Multiple installation methods coexist but may lead to duplicate entries if combined on one machine.

posts.title: obra/superpowers
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Superpowers is a comprehensive software development methodology and framework designed for AI coding agents. It structures development through stages including brainstorming, design approval, detailed planning, subagent-driven task execution, test-driven development, and rigorous code review. The system emphasizes simplicity, evidence-based verification, and systematic workflows rather than ad-hoc coding. It supports various AI coding platforms through plugins and offers commercial support options.

## 주요 기능

- Agentic skills framework enabling autonomous coding agents.
- Subagent-driven development with task decomposition and review.
- Integration of test-driven development (TDD) with enforced RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycles.
- Comprehensive collaboration skills including brainstorming, planning, code review, and branch management.

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Accelerating software development by autonomous AI agents following clear plans.
- Ensuring high-quality code via systematic testing and reviews.
- Managing complex coding projects with modular subagent task delegation.
- Supporting multiple AI coding platforms through a unified methodology.

## 시작하기

Installation varies by platform; users install the Superpowers plugin via their respective AI coding agent’s marketplace or plugin system. The README provides detailed install commands for many environments including Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Gemeni CLI, and others.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Skill updates must be compatible across all supported coding agents.
- Contributions of new skills are generally not accepted to maintain system integrity.
- Long AI sessions may lose bootstrap effects due to session compaction on some platforms (e.g., Hermes Agent).
- Visual companion telemetry is enabled by default but can be opt-out via environment variables to protect usage privacy.

posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

ECC is an open-source engineering system designed to optimize AI agents' development workflows. It provides coordinated planning, testing, implementation, review, verification, memory, and improvement processes tailored for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex. ECC includes over 70 specialized agents, 300 skills, commands, hooks, rules, and security scanning tools to enhance productivity and code quality. The system supports multiple harnesses and integrates with various LLM-based coding tools through native plugins or adapters.

## 주요 기능

- Coordinated engineering workflow with planning, testing, review, and continuous improvement.
- Extensive library of 72 agents and 327 skills covering development, security, research, and more.
- Native plugin support for Claude Code, Codex, and adapters for many other coding harnesses.
- AgentShield security scanning and continuous learning with hooks and memory management.

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Enhancing AI agent-based code generation with structured development processes.
- Automating code review, testing, and code quality checks within AI coding workflows.
- Integrating AI engineering skills and workflows into multiple LLM-based coding platforms.
- Improving productivity and reducing manual repetition for AI-assisted software projects.

## 시작하기

Use the guided setup with Node.js 18+ by running 'npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup' for Claude Code plugin installation. The process includes prerequisite checks for Git, Claude Code, and Node, then allows choosing install scopes and hook profiles interactively. Detailed setup steps are available for Windows and other environments. Alternate installation methods exist for Codex and other harnesses, with native plugin commands for Claude Code also supported.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Install ECC only from verified official sources to avoid malware risks.
- Do not stack multiple installation methods for the same harness to prevent conflicts or duplication.
- Ensure all prerequisites like Node.js 18+, Git, and Claude Code 2.1+ are installed and accessible in PATH before setup.

posts.title: firecrawl/firecrawl: Knowledge infrastructure for smarter AI agents with unified search and scraping API
posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Firecrawl provides a comprehensive infrastructure enabling AI agents to search, scrape, and interact with web data effectively. It offers Firecrawl Local for running a single binary scraper on your own machine and Firecrawl Cloud for scalable, hosted services including access to over 550 data providers via Firecrawl Alexandria. The platform supports multiple features such as clean markdown conversion, site crawling, automated agent actions, and an API usable via various SDKs across popular programming languages. It also facilitates self-hosting for full server deployment with required backend services.

## 주요 기능

- Unified API to access web data, scraping, crawling, and search
- Supports AI-driven interaction and autonomous agents on web content
- Converts web pages to clean markdown, JSON, screenshots, and structured data
- Integrates with 550+ external data providers through Firecrawl Alexandria

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Enhance AI agents with real-time web scraping and search capabilities
- Autonomous information retrieval across multiple web sources and data providers
- Batch scraping and mapping websites to gather extensive content
- Integrate with AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, or custom agents via MCP

## 시작하기

For local use, install Firecrawl Local via Rust's cargo package manager. Basic commands allow scraping a page, crawling sites, or running a local API server. Cloud usage requires signing up at firecrawl.dev for an API key and using available SDKs or CLI for search, scrape, crawl, agent, and interact functions.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Users must respect websites' robots.txt and terms of service when scraping
- Firecrawl Local relies on local environment setup including Rust and a C compiler
- Self-hosting requires additional infrastructure including Redis, PostgreSQL, and browser services
- Some advanced features like Alexandria data providers are only available via Firecrawl Cloud

posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Superpowers is a comprehensive software development methodology designed for coding agents. It starts by eliciting clear project specifications through interactive brainstorming, then creates detailed implementation plans with bite-sized tasks. The system enforces test-driven development with continuous review, using subagent-driven workflows for autonomous task execution. It integrates with multiple coding agent platforms through plugins, adapting to different environments. The focus is on systematic, evidence-based software delivery emphasizing simplicity and verification.

## 주요 기능

- Interactive brainstorming to clarify project requirements before coding.
- Automated planning that breaks work into small, test-driven tasks.
- Subagent-driven development enabling parallel task execution and review.
- Integration with various coding agents via dedicated plugins and marketplaces.

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Automating software development workflows with AI coding agents.
- Ensuring test-driven, systematic development in complex projects.
- Facilitating parallelized multi-agent task breakdown and execution.
- Enhancing collaboration between developers and AI through structured plans and reviews.

## 시작하기

Installation depends on the target coding agent, with Superpowers available as plugins in multiple marketplaces such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others. Users install the plugin per their platform using provided commands or marketplace interfaces and restart sessions to activate skills.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Installation procedures vary significantly across different coding agents and must be followed per platform.
- Long sessions in some agents (e.g., Hermes) may lose skill activation after session compactions, requiring fresh sessions.
- Certain features depend on active approvals or restarting sessions to trigger hooks properly.
- Contributions of new skills are generally not accepted unless maintaining compatibility with all supported agents.

posts.author: devlog · GitHub Trending
posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Firecrawl은 AI 에이전트가 더 똑똑해지도록 지원하는 지식 인프라를 제공합니다. 단일 API를 통해 550개 이상의 데이터 공급자를 검색, 스크랩, 접근할 수 있으며, 로컬 실행 및 클라우드 호스팅, 자체 호스팅 옵션을 갖추고 있습니다. 웹사이트를 구조화된 마크다운, JSON 등으로 변환하고, AI 에이전트와 통합하여 웹 상호작용, 검색, 크롤링, 에이전트 기반 자율 수집 기능을 제공합니다. 다양한 SDK와 CLI 툴을 통해 여러 언어 환경에 쉽게 연동할 수 있습니다.

## 주요 기능

- 550개 이상의 데이터 공급자에 단일 API로 접근 가능
- 웹사이트를 클린한 마크다운, 구조화된 JSON, 스크린샷 등으로 스크랩
- AI 에이전트에서 직접 사용할 수 있는 인터랙션 및 자율 에이전트 기능 제공
- 로컬, 클라우드, 자체 호스팅 방식 모두 지원

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- AI 에이전트에 실시간 웹 데이터 공급 및 지식 확장
- 웹사이트 전체 크롤링과 데이터 저장 자동화
- 검색 기능과 웹 페이지 스크랩을 통한 정보 수집 및 분석
- 비즈니스용 데이터 제공자 및 라이브 웹 데이터 통합

## 시작하기

로컬에서 Rust 환경과 C 컴파일러를 준비한 후 'cargo install firecrawl-local'을 실행하여 Firecrawl Local을 설치합니다. 이후 명령어로 웹 페이지를 스크랩, 크롤, 맵핑하거나 API 서버를 로컬에서 실행할 수 있습니다. 클라우드 버전은 별도 가입 없이 npx cli 명령어로 사용 가능합니다.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- 웹사이트의 로봇 배제 표준과 이용 약관을 준수해야 함
- 로컬 실행 시 Rust 환경과 시스템 의존성(예: Xcode, build-essential)이 필요함
- 자체 호스팅 시 Redis, PostgreSQL 등 외부 서비스 구성 필요
- 클라우드 API 사용 시 API 키 및 과금 정책을 확인해야 함

posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Superpowers is a comprehensive software development methodology designed to work with coding agents by leveraging a composable set of skills and structured instructions. It guides coding agents through a disciplined workflow starting from eliciting clear specifications, creating plans, to autonomous subagent-driven development with a strong emphasis on test-driven development principles. The system enforces systematic processes, code reviews, and continuous verification to enhance reliability and maintainability. Multiple plugin installation methods support various coding agent platforms, facilitating integration with tools like Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, and others.

## 주요 기능

- Agent-driven, stepwise software design and specification elicitation before coding
- Subagent-driven development process enabling autonomous task execution and review
- Test-driven development emphasized with RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycles and deletion of untested code
- Integrated skills for debugging, collaboration, and systematic workflows within coding agents

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- Automated software project planning and development with AI coding agents
- Enhancing code quality and testing discipline via enforced TDD methodology
- Parallel and autonomous task execution in coding workflows using subagents
- Analyzing and diagnosing issues in coding agent sessions to improve performance

## 시작하기

Installation varies by coding agent platform. Instructions include commands to install Superpowers as plugins from official marketplaces or directly from the repository for supported agents such as Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Cursor, Devin CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and others. Users should follow platform-specific plugin installation commands documented individually in the README sections.

## 도입 전에 확인할 점

- Skill updates must maintain compatibility across all supported coding agents
- Agent-written pull requests fixing issues filed by others are generally not accepted unless requested by maintainers
- Long sessions may lose the skill bootstrap in some agents lacking post-compaction hooks, requiring session restarts
- Telemetry is optional and disabled by environment variables; users should configure this according to privacy preferences

posts.content:
## 한눈에 보기

Firecrawl은 AI 에이전트를 더 똑똑하게 만들기 위한 지식 인프라를 제공하는 오픈소스 프로젝트입니다. 사용자는 로컬에서 또는 클라우드 환경에서 웹사이트를 크롤링, 스크랩, 맵핑할 수 있으며, 550여 개 이상의 데이터 공급자를 단일 API로 이용할 수 있습니다. 다양한 포맷으로 정제된 콘텐츠를 제공하며, AI 에이전트와의 인터랙션, 자율적 정보 수집이 가능합니다. SDK를 통해 Python, Node.js 등 여러 언어에서 쉽게 접근할 수 있습니다.

## 주요 기능

- 로컬 및 클라우드에서 웹스크래핑, 크롤링, 맵핑 지원
- 550개 이상의 데이터 공급자와 통합된 단일 API 제공
- AI 에이전트를 위한 인터랙션 기능과 자율 데이터 수집 에이전트 기능
- 다양한 언어 SDK 및 CLI 지원으로 편리한 개발 환경 제공

## 이런 경우에 활용할 수 있어요

- AI 에이전트에 실시간 웹 데이터 제공 및 검색 기능 통합
- 웹사이트 콘텐츠를 마크다운 등 LLM 친화적 포맷으로 변환

- 550+ 데이터 소스를 이용해 기업, 인물, 연구 논문 등 데이터 보강

## 시작하기

로컬에서 사용하려면 Rust와 C 컴파일러 환경을 갖춘 후 cargo 명령어로 firecrawl-local을 설치합니다. 설치 후 명령어를 통해 스크래핑, 크롤링, 맵핑 등의 작업을 수행할 수 있으며 AI 에이전트 연동도 지원됩니다.

- 웹사이트의 로봇배제기준(robots.txt) 및 서비스 약관을 준수해야 함
- 자체 호스팅 시 데이터베이스, 큐, 워커 등 서버 인프라를 별도 구축해야 함
